    What is the meaning of the word Al?
    a suffix with the general sense “of the kind of, pertaining to, having the form or character of” that named by the stem, occurring in loanwords from Latin (autumnal; natural; pastoral ), and productive in English on the Latin model, usually with bases of Latin origin (accidental; seasonal; tribal ).

    Is it al or al for Alabama?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    It's AL for Alabama, the standard two-letter postal abbreviation used by the USPS and other official sources, though historically or in some styles, "Ala." was used, but AL (all caps) is the modern, common, and correct abbreviation. 
    Key Points: 
    • USPS: AL (all caps).
    • Traditional: Ala. (with a period).
    • Modern Standard: AL is the universally recognized code for mail and data.

      What is al short for?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      AL is a common abbreviation for Alabama, the US state, but can also stand for Aluminum (chemical symbol), the American League in baseball, Anglo-Latin, or the Arabic prefix "al-" meaning "the". The specific meaning depends on the context, from postal codes to chemistry. 
      Common Meanings of AL
      • Alabama (AL): The postal abbreviation for the U.S. state. 
      • Aluminum (Al): The chemical symbol for the element aluminum. 
      • American League (AL): A major league in baseball. 
      • "al-" (prefix): A prefix from Arabic meaning "the," as in Algebra or Alchemy. 
      • Anglo-Latin (AL): Relating to English and Latin. 
      Other Uses
      • Artificial Intelligence (AL): Sometimes used for AI, though AI is more common. 
      • Annual Leave (AL): Used in HR and employment contexts. 
      • Attoliter (aL): An SI unit for volume.

        Which state is AL in the US?
        An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
        AI Overview
        "AL" is the two-letter abbreviation for the state of Alabama, a southeastern U.S. state known for its rich history, diverse geography, and culture, with its capital in Montgomery. 
        • Official Website: Alabama.gov
        • Key Cities: Montgomery, Huntsville (largest city), Birmingham.
        • History: Became the 22nd state in 1819.
        • Key Attractions: Gulf Coast beaches, Space and Rocket Center in Huntsville, and Civil Rights landmarks in Montgomery.
